_comment: Copy to systems.json (gitignored) or point SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE at it. One entry per ABAP system (destination); tools take a `destination` argument naming one of these keys. Mark one entry with "default": true to use it when destination is omitted. Optional per-entry gitUser/gitPassword supply abapGit credentials so they never pass through the model. Optional per-entry "policy" block: readOnly, deniedTools (globs), allowDataPreview, allowFreeSql, deniedTables (globs), allowedPackages (globs, closed), allowedTransports (globs, no new transports). Table data is closed unless stated: allowDataPreview=true opens tableContents by name, allowFreeSql=true opens runQuery and implies the former (MCP_ALLOW_DATA_PREVIEW=1 / MCP_ALLOW_FREE_SQL=1 set the default for entries that do not state the key). MCP_READ_ONLY=1 makes every destination read-only. Optional per-entry "tls": ca (extra CA bundle), cert+key or pfx+passphrase (client certificate). authType=sso2 accepts an ephemeral ticket from a trusted local provider; see docs/AUTH.md.
